table.retrieve:
SELECT  
	dbo.gldetail.invoicecode,
	invdate=GetDate(),
	NetAmt=0.00,
	dbo.gldetail.OutStandingAmt,
	fullcode=dbo.accounts.aliasname,
	dbo.gldetail.acccode,
	dbo.gldetail.chkno,
	dbo.gldetail.remarks,
	dbo.gldetail.glvochcode ,
	regno = (SELECT regno FROM Patient WHERE Patient.PatientCode = dbo.gldetail.patientcode),
	dbo.gldetail.patientcode,
	patient = (SELECT Name FROM Patient WHERE Patient.PatientCode = dbo.gldetail.patientcode),
	guestregno = (SELECT regno FROM Guest WHERE Guest.GuestCode = dbo.gldetail.Guestcode),
	dbo.gldetail.guestcode,
	guest = (SELECT name FROM Guest WHERE Guest.GuestCode = dbo.gldetail.Guestcode),
	Studentregno = (SELECT regno FROM Student WHERE Student.StudentCode = dbo.gldetail.Studentcode),
	dbo.gldetail.studentcode,
	Student = (SELECT name FROM Student WHERE Student.StudentCode = dbo.gldetail.Studentcode),
	GLROWID=dbo.gldetail.IDENTITYCOL,
	GLUTN=dbo.gldetail.GLUTN,
	dbo.gldetail.balance,
	dbo.gldetail.foreignamt,
	dbo.gldetail.debit,
	dbo.gldetail.credit
	
FROM
	dbo.gldetail ,
	dbo.glheader, 
	dbo.accounts
	
WHERE
   ( dbo.glheader.glvochcode = :ar_VochCode ) and
	( dbo.glheader.glvochcode = dbo.gldetail.glvochcode ) and
	( dbo.gldetail.acccode = dbo.accounts.acccode )
ORDER BY
	dbo.gldetail.IDENTITYCOL

objects.name: c_tot_effective_balance
objects.expression: abs( sum(balance + debit - credit for all) )

objects.name: c_tot_effective_balance_type
objects.expression: if( sum( balance + debit - credit for all) >= 0 , 'Dr','Cr')
